thread:
lucy_sales: Heads-up from Orbis POC call -- streaming stopped mid-message in their web demo. They saw `Unexpected end of JSON input` and left the meeting frustrated.

diego_se: Oof. Do we have the raw payload or har? Cc @nora_eng

lucy_sales: They pasted the console snippet: `data: {\"choices\":[{\"text\":\"We're updat"}` (no trailing newline/event).

nora_eng: Sounds like the SSE event was truncated by a proxy/edge. Can we get the session id?

lucy_sales: session: orbis-q1-2178. They said internal edge with aggressive idle timeouts.

kai_cs: Orbis confirmed their timeout is 4s on in-flight writes and they rewrite some headers.

diego_se: Immediate triage: 1) Quick SDK change to buffer until a full `\n\n` event or valid JSON before parse (fast). 2) Recommend their edge settings: `proxy_buffering off; proxy_read_timeout 30s;` and preserve Transfer-Encoding (medium).

nora_eng: I'll check server logs for that session. Deploy-bot: created incident INC-9942 for Orbis SSE truncation.

deploy-bot: Incident INC-9942 created, assigned to nora_eng.

nora_eng: Logs show our writes: 384 bytes then a 64-byte tail; upstream returned `upstream prematurely closed connection` on tail write. Repro'd locally by simulating nginx with short read timeout.

diego_se: I'll prepare a 0.5.1 hotfix with defensive client buffering and text example: ```js
let buf=''; source.on('data',c=>{buf+=c; const parts=buf.split(/\\n\\n/); buf=parts.pop()||''; parts.forEach(p=>{try{const d=JSON.parse(p.replace(/^data:\\s*/,'')); deliver(d);}catch(e){}})});
```

kai_cs: Also need a one-paragraph security note: SSE vs websocket risks, TLS mention, and required headers to pass. I'll draft and send to Orbis security.

lucy_sales: Thanks. Plan: ship SDK hotfix, get HAR from Orbis in pairing session at 15:00 PT, send proxy-config note and security blurb, and include Dedicated as a pricing option but document it won't fix their internal edge. Keep me updated. :thumbsup:
